confirmed: Every outcome is scored on the submitted solutions, and none is self-reported. Blind evaluators rated quality, novelty, feasibility, impact, business potential (1-10), and technicality (1-7). Length is a word count. Figure 13 uses sentence-embedding distances (pp. 12-14, Section 4.2; p. 48, App. B.3; p. 40, Figure 13).

AI was available to T2 and T3 while they wrote the scored solution. Every reported result comes from the initial task, before the control groups' crossover, so ai_available_when_produced 'yes' and timing 'immediate' hold, and no after_ai outcome exists (p. 10, Section 3.2; p. 11, Section 3.3).
For participants' outputs the question codes follow the codebook rule: S1-O3 (diversity, AI available) is across_people, and the eight other outcomes are with_ai (codebook section 1).

S1-O3 compares the solutions of different individuals or teams within each condition, so diversity, not flexibility, is the right construct. The measure is a sentence-embedding distance, and the model is not named (p. 40, Figure 13 note; p. 19, Section 6.4).

The S1-O3 figure readings hold. Reading a 300-dpi render gives modes of about 0.33 (AI Only), 0.59 (Pair + AI), 0.61 (Alone + AI), 0.71 (Alone), and 0.71 (Pair). The three human-arm contrasts are treatment_lower, as the text says (p. 40, Figure 13; p. 19, Section 6.4).

Unit 'output' and n_units 550 are the paper's own. The model is written 'for a given solution generated i', and Tables 2, 3, and 10 report 550 observations (p. 12, Section 4.1; p. 42, Tables 2-3; p. 46, Table 10).

S1-O1 is the outcome the paper names as primary: Overall Quality on a 1-10 scale, averaged over 1,595 ratings of 550 solutions (2.89 each, ICC2 0.452) and standardized on Individual No AI. Construct usefulness fits 'quality of a single output' (pp. 12-13, Section 4.2; p. 48, App. B.3; p. 49, App. B.4).

expert_raters follows the paper's own words ('expert evaluators', 'domain experts'). The panel was MBA or engineering students or recent graduates, and the form discloses this (p. 48, App. B.1; p. 49, App. B.4).
The Table 5 Model 1 numbers match: non-core 0.324 (0.149) with 218 observations, core 0.433 (0.152) with 332 observations (p. 43, Table 5).

S1-O1 directions hold. Team + AI vs Team No AI has p = 0.216 to 0.254. The text calls Individual + AI 'comparable' to Team No AI, and the right panel of Figure 3 overlays exactly those two arms (p. 42, Table 2; pp. 14-15, Section 5.1; p. 31, Figure 3).

S1-O8 numbers match Table 3: Individual + AI 504.507, 511.568, 503.833, Team + AI 543.745, 556.997, 551.578, and Team No AI 30.456, 56.746, 57.184, each with its printed SE, control means 381.422, 306.565, 336.197, and N = 550. Construct elaboration fits a length measure (p. 42, Table 3; p. 13, Section 4.2).

S1-O4 numbers match Table 10, including both p-value rows (0.190, 0.207, 0.175 and 0.061, 0.077, 0.069). The text says the individual effect is not significant, so no_clear_difference holds (p. 46, Table 10; p. 17, Section 6.1).

S1-O9 Team + AI vs Team No AI: the bimodality coefficients 0.564 and 0.482 are as printed, and no_clear_difference follows the text's 'similar overall levels of technical content'. The unlabeled dashed lines in Figure 11 sit at about 3.5 and 3.8 (p. 18, Section 6.3; p. 39, Figure 11).
S1-O7 rightly has no contrast. Business potential is defined in App. B.3 and reported nowhere (p. 48, App. B.3; p. 11, Section 3.2).

No outcome that bears on the three questions is missing. Expected Quality and the emotion measures are self-reports. Time on task is not scored on the output. The retention rate has no no-AI arm. The AI-evaluation replication (fn. 11) is a robustness variant noted under S1-O1, and the crossover task has no reported results (p. 18, Sections 6.2 and 6.4; p. 39, Figure 12; p. 43, Table 4; pp. 44-45, Tables 6-9; p. 13, fn. 11; p. 11, Section 3.3).
summary: Criterion 3 holds for c052: blind evaluators rated every submitted solution on quality, the paper's primary outcome (Table 2), Figure 13 compares sentence-embedding distances across solutions, AI was available when the AI arms wrote them, and every table number in the form matches the PDF. The coding is still refuted on details: the novelty, feasibility, and impact directions are inferred from one blanket sentence, the 'mixed' technicality direction rests on an opposite-sign claim that Figure 6 does not show, the GPT-4o 'AI Only' row sits inside an across_people record, and length is coded automated_score against the codebook definition.
